name: careerpack
description: CareerPack workflows for CVs, job applications, career roadmaps, portfolios, documents, and career planning through the registered CareerPack app.

interface.shortDescription: Build and manage your career pack
interface.longDescription: Use CareerPack to work with CVs, job applications, document checklists, skill roadmaps, portfolios, schedules, and other career data through the registered CareerPack app and its OAuth-protected MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Review my current CV and tell me the highest-impact improvements for the role I am targeting.
Show my active job applications and help me plan the next follow-up for each one.
Use my CareerPack data to prepare a focused career plan for the next 30 days.
